summary: Full backend + frontend E2E validation of Task 0 (role rename/split manager|admin|waiter) and Task 1 (protected deletion of already-sent order items). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_features_iter7.py (18 tests) and repaired 13 stale assertions in the existing suite that still expected the OLD admin/cashier roles, the old recipe unit and the pre-Task-1 void contract. Full suite now 95 passed / 3 xfailed (documented gaps). Two backend input-validation gaps also found (arbitrary staff role accepted; PUT /staff can create a PIN-login manager).

minor.issue: `role` is not validated against an enum. POST /staff with role='superuser' returns 200 and creates a ghost user with NO pin and NO email/password (both credential checks are keyed on role in ('waiter','admin') / =='manager'). Add Literal['manager','admin','waiter'] to StaffReq. (Reproduced: two such users were created by the old test suite and had to be deleted manually.)

Privilege/auth weakening: a PIN-only waiter can be updated to role='manager' while keeping the PIN, with no email/password required. POST /api/auth/pin-login with that 4-digit PIN then returns role=manager and grants full back-office access (GET /staff and GET /reports/corrections both 200). PUT should enforce the same rule as POST (manager => email+password, and must not keep/accept a pin).

Seeded staff NAMES were not migrated with the roles: the manager is still named 'Администратор' and the admin/cashier (PIN 2222) is still 'Кассир Мария'. UI therefore shows 'Кассир Мария — Администратор (касса)' and 'Администратор — Менеджер', which is confusing and contradicts the brief's 'Администратор Мария'. Also the Staff page subtitle still reads 'Официанты/кассиры входят по PIN'.
Cosmetic: breakdown card is still labelled 'По кассирам' after the rename; consider 'По администраторам' or 'По сотрудникам'.

integration_issues.flow: POS — delete a not-yet-sent (pending) item from an order that already exists on the server
integration_issues.issue: HIGH. Items added to the cart are only persisted by saveOrder() (send/pay/bill/move/split). requestVoid() for a pending item calls voidItem(index) -> DELETE /orders/{id}/items/{index} using the LOCAL cart index. For an already-saved order the new item does not exist server-side, so the request returns 404 and the user gets the error toast 'Позиция не найдена' and the item STAYS in the cart. Reproduced deterministically as both waiter (1111) and admin (2222): open table -> add item -> Отправить на кухню -> add a second (pending) item -> click its trash icon => HTTP 404 DELETE /api/orders/<id>/items/1. This directly breaks the Task-1 requirement 'deleting a not-yet-sent item stays instant'. It works only when the order has never been saved (store.orderId === null). Because the index is local, a count mismatch could also delete the WRONG server item. Suggested fix in Pos.jsx voidItem(): for a pending line, do store.removeItem(index) locally and then persist with PUT /orders/{id} (or DELETE the order when the cart becomes empty) instead of the index-based DELETE.

critical_code_review_comments: Index-based item API (DELETE /orders/{oid}/items/{idx}) is inherently unsafe with an optimistic local cart and with two waiters on the same bill — an item-level uuid would remove the whole class of 404/wrong-item bugs.

Pos.jsx confirmVoid() requires a PIN whenever user.role !== 'admin'; backend accepts 'admin' OR 'manager' as self-confirmers. Harmless today (managers cannot reach /pos) but the two checks should use the same predicate.

requestVoid() opens the protected modal only for print_status === 'printed', while the backend treats any status != 'pending' as sent. Today only those two values exist, so they agree — but if a 'queued'/'failed' status is ever added the UI would silently send a reason-less DELETE and get a 400.

Role migration in seed() is guarded by settings key role_migration_v1; if the settings collection is ever reset while users survive, update_many({'role':'admin'}->'manager') would wrongly promote every cashier-admin to manager. Consider keying the flag off the users collection or making it idempotent.
seed() never repairs the role of the existing ADMIN_EMAIL user — if that document's role is changed, the manager is locked out of the back-office with no recovery path.
Pos.jsx is 587 lines with 10+ modals inline; splitting the void/checkout/split/move modals into components would help maintainability.

rca_of_the_issue: Pending-item delete 404: POS keeps an optimistic local cart (useCart store) that is flushed to the server only by saveOrder() on send/pay/bill/move/split. requestVoid() branches on print_status and, for pending lines, calls voidItem(index) -> DELETE /orders/{orderId}/items/{index}. When the order already exists on the server but the pending line was added afterwards, the local index is out of range for the server's items array, so void_order_item() raises 404 'Позиция не найдена' and the cart is never updated. Fix: for a pending line remove it from the local store and persist with PUT /orders/{orderId} {items} (or DELETE /orders/{orderId} when the cart becomes empty), keeping the index-based DELETE strictly for lines that came from the server.
